headline: Qualcomm Shares Fall 10% Amid Margin Headwinds and Rising Costs
summary: Qualcomm stock dropped 10% following reports of margin headwinds and increased operational costs. The company faces pressure as it navigates rising expenses in its semiconductor business.
why: Qualcomm is a leading global semiconductor company. Margin compression in this sector often signals competitive pressure or rising input costs that affect profitability.

impacts.name: Qualcomm
impacts.why: Rising costs and margin headwinds negatively impact earnings expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors react negatively to margin compression as it directly threatens the company's ability to maintain earnings growth in a competitive semiconductor market.
